The 21 collision fibers and all 45 degree signatures are checked by independently replayable code, with separately verified threefold masks and Seidel polynomials. No extrapolation beyond n=8 is made.

value.rationale: The complete coherent-triple grade polynomial is a canonical refinement of the number of one-point types of the countable homogeneous two-graph. Its first exact reconstruction failure, complete minimal exceptional fiber classification, and degree-incidence recovery are natural structural boundaries, not arbitrary small-statistic numerology. The explicit triple collision has pairwise distinct Seidel spectra, showing a nontrivial independent information loss. The scope is exact and finite, which is meaningful without an asymptotic theorem.
